VASCULAR SURGERY

Antimicrobial prophylaxis is not recommended for some procedures, including

brachiocephalic procedures (e.g., carotid endarterectomy, brachial artery

repair) without implantation of prosthetic material.

Antimicrobial prophylaxis is recommended in vascular procedures that involve

implantation of prosthetic material and procedures for which there is greater

risk of infection, such as aneurysm repair, thromboendarterectomy and vein

bypass. Longer duration of antimicrobial prophylaxis therapy is warranted for

graft placement.

# If no antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended, select below:

# *Prophylaxis for graft placement procedures:

# Preferred:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

Post-op prophylaxis include q8h x2doses.

Please plase post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis order after admission.

# Alternative for beta lactam allergy or MRSA colonization:

[Click here Beta-lactam reaction assessment](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Vancomycin 15mg/kg Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)

Post-op prophylaxis include q12h x1dose.

Please place post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis order after admission.
